configurations.name: commerce-api-pgvector
runtimeArgs: cd commerce-api && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://shop:shop@localhost:5434/shop exec npm run start:dev

configurations.name: agent-service
runtimeArgs: cd agent-service && exec env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL -u CLAUDE_EFFORT .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000

configurations.name: agent-service-images
runtimeArgs: cd agent-service && exec env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL -u CLAUDE_EFFORT IMAGES_ENABLED=true JWT_SECRET="$(grep '^JWT_SECRET=' ../commerce-api/.env | cut -d= -f2-)" SERVICE_TOKEN="$(grep '^SERVICE_TOKEN=' ../commerce-api/.env | cut -d= -f2-)" .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
